text: Thirty-nine years... Whis. The dream again. Find me that Saiyan.
Thirty-nine years asleep; one blink behind my eyes,
While empires turned to embers in the corners of the skies.
No cradle, no confession, just the office and the blade;
I am what the light requires when its monuments decay.
The Kais may seed the heavens; I decide what cannot stay—
A garden chokes on everything its keeper fears to slay.
Yet through my sacred silence came a flash of burning red:
A stranger crowned in godfire, standing where my dreams lay dead.
Whis, strike the hour—
I can taste the coming storm.
My boredom splits like thunder;
Something WORTHY takes a form.
DIVINITY! Hear the pillars BEND!
HAKAI! I am the mercy of the END!
One finger, one silence—watch the constellations fall;
I don't need a throne when I can UNMAKE it all.
Rise, crimson warrior—make the black sky BRIGHT;
Prove that something mortal deserves another night!
One flick—a world forgets the shape its monuments once wore;
One yawn—the fiercest warlord cannot rise to wage a war.
Champa snarls across the stars; let my brother count his feasts,
I want thunder in the silence, not another kneeling beast.
I can feast upon a thousand worlds, then sleep until they're gone;
But that phantom pulse keeps pounding like a war-drum before dawn.
There's a little blue world turning where that crimson fire may breathe;
Whis, prepare the journey—bring me SOMETHING to believe.
Let the silence split WIDE OPEN;
Let the sleeping stars ignite.
If a mortal wears godfire,
He can earn the right to FIGHT!
DIVINITY! Hear the pillars BEND!
HAKAI! I am the mercy of the END!
One finger, one silence—watch the constellations fall;
I don't need a throne when I can UNMAKE it all.
Rise, crimson warrior—make the black sky BRIGHT;
Prove that something mortal deserves another night!
Whis... is that a smile? Don't mock me.
I haven't felt this awake
In thirty-nine years.
A little thread named Shin can bring a god down to his knees;
Even cosmic kings have chains that no one ever sees.
And above me, Zeno laughs—such a small and sovereign sound;
Tell me, what is DIVINITY when every god is bound?
I was made to clear the garden, not to grieve for every rose;
Still that crimson ghost inside my dreams refuses to let go.
If he rises, I will meet him. If he fails, a world may fall—
But if he makes me HESITATE... perhaps that says it ALL!
DIVINITY! Hear the pillars BEND!
HAKAI! I am the mercy of the END!
One finger, one silence—watch the constellations fall;
I don't need a throne when I can UNMAKE it all.
Rise, crimson warrior—make the black sky BRIGHT;
Prove that something mortal deserves another night!
The clouds are blue beyond the glass; the stars begin to thin.
A silent world revolves below, unaware of what's within.
Whis, slow the journey—let anticipation climb.
One last breath of silence... then we'll see who's worth my time.
Now... show me this Super Saiyan God.
